articles.title: Courtney Stodden addresses ‘Seinfeld’ star Jason Alexander’s apology donation for ‘inappropriate’ comedy sketch
articles.summary: Courtney Stodden thanked actor Jason Alexander for an apology donation. This gesture followed Stodden's public criticism of Alexander's "inappropriate" comedy sketch from 2012. Stodden expressed gratitude for his "beautiful gesture" after calling him out for the decade-old material, highlighting a public figure addressing past controversial content.

articles.title: A field experiment found working adults randomly assigned to spend $40 saving themselves time, paying someone to clean or run an errand, reported significantly greater happiness than when they spent the same $40 on a material purchase, while a separate study of over 4,000 people found those who said they’d choose more time over more money were consistently happier, even accounting for how much time and money they actually had
articles.summary: The article discusses the common notion that time is non-refundable, unlike money, often disregarded in busy schedules. It introduces two studies using real money to investigate this. These studies aim to explore how individuals truly value their time when financial incentives are involved, challenging the casual neglect of time management despite acknowledging its importance. This research delves into behavioral economic principles of valuing time.

articles.title: A runway, nearly 1,000 runners and a morning of EAA memories
articles.summary: Nearly 1,000 runners transformed Wittman Regional Airport in Oshkosh, Wisconsin, into an unusual race course on July 25 for the EAA AirVenture Runway 5K. This unique charity run/walk allowed participants to traverse the airport's tarmac, offering a distinctive experience while supporting a good cause. It highlights community engagement through unique events.
